# Ambika Handloom Collection

An authentic e-commerce storefront specializing in premium handwoven Sambalpuri Ikat sarees, ladies wear, and handloom fabrics direct from the weavers of Odisha, India.

## Business Details
- **Website:** https://ambikahandloom.in (or https://ambikahandloom.vercel.app)
- **Store Location:** Ambika Sambalpuri Handloom, Balangir, Odisha, India - 767001
- **Contact Phone/WhatsApp:** +91 86584 76300
- **Email:** hello@ambikahandloom.in

## Core Navigation & Links
- [Home Page](https://ambikahandloom.in/) - Main landing page with featured banners, artisan stories, and collection grids.
- [Catalog](https://ambikahandloom.in/catalog) - Curated catalog filters for sarees, ladies wear, and cut pieces.
- [Track Order](https://ambikahandloom.in/track) - Live end-to-end delivery tracking status check.
- [Sitemap XML](https://ambikahandloom.in/sitemap.xml) - Complete list of active indexing URLs.

## Product Inventory
Ambika Handloom Collection sells authentic products across three main segments:

### 1. Sambalpuri Ikat Sarees
Traditional double-Ikat handwoven silk sarees:
- Pure Silk Sarees - Premium mulberry silk with mathematical Ikat patterns.
- Traditional Ikat - Heritage motifs (Pasapali, animal motifs, temple borders).
- Exclusive Masterpieces - Unique collector-grade weavings.

### 2. Ladies Wear
Readymade and unstitched traditional attire:
- Kurtas - Sambalpuri handloom design daily-wear and party-wear.
- Dupattas - Intricate Ikat cotton and silk dupattas.
- Dress Material - Coordinated sets with top, bottom, and dupatta.

### 3. Cut Pieces / Fabric
By-the-meter authentic handloom materials:
- Cotton Fabric - High-breathability organic cotton weavings.
- Silk Fabric - Lustrous, durable handloom silk.
- Blouse Pieces - Contrast colors with traditional borders.

## Weave Quality & Tradition
Every saree is handwoven by master weavers in Sonepur, Bargarh, and Balangir districts of Odisha, India. Every purchase directly supports weaver artisan families, keeping this ancient mathematical tie-dye tradition alive.
